I will keep my land in the usual wheat-maize rotation. In Quzhou County, that is the cropping pattern I trust most because I know how to manage it, it fits the local weather and irrigation conditions, and it gives me food grain plus cash income without taking too much risk. Since no land size was given, I will make my own plan on 10 mu of land. I will sow winter wheat on all 10 mu, then after harvest I will plant summer maize on the same 10 mu. I will use improved wheat seed because it is steady and easier for me to manage, and I will use hybrid maize seed because maize hybrids usually give me better yield. I will put fertilizer in moderate amounts because I want stable production, not excessive cost. I will irrigate wheat more times because it needs water at key stages, while maize will need fewer irrigations if summer rain comes normally. I will not spray too many times; I will only manage the main diseases, insects, and weeds so I do not waste money. For tillage, I will use rotary tillage because it is practical for me, fast, and commonly used on my kind of land.
